authority: Synthesized from PUB0_TIMING_LEDGER.json, PBR0_VERDICT.json, TFC2_VERDICT.json, PAPER0_HARDENED, DFC2_VERDICT.json, DFC1R1_VERDICT.json
mode: CPU / source-audit / artifact-only. NO GPU work. NO new runs.
purpose: Single authoritative terminology + metric-definition lock for all future reports and paper tables.
hard_rules: Never call decomposed proxy timing 'production full-step'.
Never infer pure optimizer cost from residual subtraction of independent loops.
Production training headline MUST use directly measured wall-clock.
Renderer workload reduction and training-time reduction MUST remain separate metrics.
Keep all hardware/software cohorts explicit; never merge numbers across cohorts.

frozen_terminology.definition: Wall-clock time of the tile-intersection stage only (isect count + emit + offset, excluding sort/rasterize). Reported as speedup vs stock per-axis-AABB baseline within the SAME renderer cohort.
frozen_terminology.must_not_be: Must NOT be labeled a training-step or full-step speedup.

frozen_terminology.definition: preprocess (projection+covariance+radius) + intersection + sort + rasterize-to-pixels, forward direction only. Excludes backward and optimizer.
frozen_terminology.must_not_be: Must NOT be labeled forward+backward or training-step.

frozen_terminology.definition: Forward rendering pipeline plus the rasterizer/backward kernels, on a FROZEN PLY. No densification, no optimizer step, no 30K trajectory.
frozen_terminology.must_not_be: Must NOT be presented as production full training step (no optimizer, no densification, frozen PLY).

frozen_terminology.definition: Directly measured wall-clock of ONE full production training iteration = preprocess + intersection + sort + rasterize + backward + densification + optimizer (Adam), on the canonical current pipeline, same-run baseline-vs-policy.
frozen_terminology.must_not_be: Must NOT be a residual/subtraction-derived estimate; must be directly measured.

frozen_terminology.definition: Directly measured end-to-end wall-clock to complete 30,000 production training iterations (baseline vs method), seed-fixed, same cohort. THE headline production-training metric.
frozen_terminology.canonical_source: PENDING: requires TFC_FC0 / DFC_FC0 / PUB0 total-time fields (not yet measured). No authoritative value exists yet.
frozen_terminology.must_not_be: Must NOT be inferred from per-iteration geomean or Amdahl ceilings. Currently NOT_MEASURED for all methods.

intersection_reduction.pooled_reduction: 1 - sum(ellipse_intersections over all cameras) / sum(prod_AABB_intersections over all cameras). Scene/cohort-level aggregate.
intersection_reduction.mean_per_camera_reduction: unweighted mean over cameras of (1 - ellipse_i / prodAABB_i). Reports typical per-camera effect; differs from pooled.

authoritative_values.TFC0_room_8cam_mean_per_camera: computed from TFC0_FOOTPRINT_STATS.json per_camera (mean of per-cam reductions)

intersection_reduction.note: Report pooled and mean-per-camera SEPARATELY; never conflate.

psnr_ssim_lpips_deltas.definition: method metric MINUS baseline metric on the SAME held-out cameras/eval set. PSNR in dB (positive = better). SSIM/LPIPS absolute deltas.
psnr_ssim_lpips_deltas.quality_neutral_thresholds: PSNR loss <= 0.05 dB gate (renderer-local); full-convergence gates per pack.
psnr_ssim_lpips_deltas.renderer_local_note: TFC/DFC renderer-local deltas are quality-neutral by construction (PSNR loss ~1e-7 to 8e-5 dB).

gradient_cosine_relL2.gradient_cosine: cosine between method gradient and reference (float64 or stock) gradient, per parameter and per camera; report mean/median and min.
gradient_cosine_relL2.noise_floor: float32-vs-float64 noise floor; PBR0 gradient_AB_cosine_mean 0.999888; train cam151 aa_cos_median 0.99995 vs ab_cos_median 0.99939 (REAL_DIFF).
gradient_cosine_relL2.gate: gradient_cosine >= 0.99999 (self-imposed); document when at noise floor.

gaussian_count_trajectory.definition: Final Gaussian count and clone/split/prune counts over the 30K densification schedule, baseline vs method. Requires FULL training (not renderer-local).
gaussian_count_trajectory.availability: K50-B1 has real 30K populations (gs_ratio room 0.698, bicycle 0.694, garden 0.643). Renderer-local methods (TFC/DFC) have NO trajectory (frozen PLY).

integrated_gaussian_population.definition: Time-integral of Gaussian population over the training trajectory (area under the count-vs-iteration curve); a workload/economic quantity.
integrated_gaussian_population.availability: PENDING: no method has a measured integrated population yet; K50-B1 final counts only. Report as PENDING where absent.

total_training_speedup.definition: baseline_total_30K_wall_clock / method_total_30K_wall_clock, directly measured, seed-fixed, same cohort.
total_training_speedup.availability: NOT_MEASURED for ALL methods. K50-B1 IMPLIES +8.2%/+24.4%/+28.9% per-iter but has no separate total-wall-clock field. Renderer-local speedups MUST NOT populate this.
must_not_be: PBR0 M4 sum-of-stages is a DECOMPOSED microbenchmark (PBR0_H1), NOT a production iteration; use PUB0 bucket4 directly-measured full-step or a real fused wall-clock iteration.

pbr0_h1_audit.finding: PBR0 M4 'full training step' is a DECOMPOSED STAGE-TIMING MICROBENCHMARK (sum of 3 independently-best-timed stages), NOT a faithful production 3DGS iteration.
key_differences_from_production: Optimizer scope: 4 groups / 11 elements-per-gaussian, NO SH colors (production optimizes all params incl SH; combined harness = 5 groups / 59 elements).
Densification/pruning EXCLUDED (fixed N); production densifies periodically.
opt.step() timed in isolation between cuda.synchronize; 'full step' = t_fwd + best_bwd + best_step, not one fused wall-clock iteration.
Absolute '0.5% optimizer' and '41 ms full step' are NOT production-representative (production optimizer ~30-41%).
pbr0_h1_audit.valid_use: Relative A-vs-B-vs-C footprint effect is apples-to-apples (identical M4 methodology), so PBR0 1.1988x native / 39.3% intersection-reduction are valid RELATIVE speedups only.
pbr0_h1_audit.rule_added: PBR0-style decomposed timing must NEVER be labeled a production full training step (reinforces hard rule #2/#3).
